Can’t believe there are still ppl who think crochet clothes look ugly when I think they’re some of the most beautiful pieces ever 😤 The fact that they can’t be made by machines makes each crochet piece feel so much more soulful and special! 🥹 If you’re trying to level up ur crochet game, here are some of my tips: 1. Opt for smaller yarn sizes! I started with size 4 Aran yarn, and now I literally never touch anything thicker than DK 🫢 Thicker yarn creates bulkier pieces! 2. Experiment with different fibers & ditch those milk cotton yarns 😩 Not trying to be a hater, but my milk cotton clothes are all too hot and stiff 🫠 Try plant-fiber yarns for a more airy result, or acrylic blends for something lighter! 3. Practice, practice, practice! Tension and hook choices matter too, so keep experimenting until you find what works for you~ What do you think? Do you also think crochet clothes look ugly? 🤔 Patterns featured: YVONNE, LUNA & HUĀ by me! 🤍 Use code YVONNE25 for 25% off all patterns until August 16! Learn the Even Moss Stitch An easy crochet stitch with a simple 2-row repeat that works up quickly and creates a beautiful textured fabric. This beginner friendly crochet stitch uses just slip stitches and half double crochet (US) / half treble crochet (UK), making it easy to learn and remember. Perfect for blankets, scarves, dishcloths and lots of other crochet projects.
